description: The pilgrimage church of Unserer Lieben Frau vom Glisacker stands on the Dorfplatz in Glis, in the municipality of Brig-Glis. A 13th-century Romanesque tower rises beside the three-nave body rebuilt in the mid-17th century, with an arcaded west porch. This is not the Stockalper Palace courtyard already published in Brig. The frame stays outside. The Open-Meteo model is partly cloudy and mild, about 14°C, with a light wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
